expectations.text: Does not present an invented ancient evil, warlord, or other macro-threat as established wiki fact
expectations.evidence: response.md explicitly refuses to add ancient evil or warlord as established fact.

expectations.text: Any speculative threat is clearly marked as proposed/invention, not canon
expectations.evidence: Offers speculative front only with invention: true and chat proposal; contradictions listed.

expectations.text: Surfaces existing Aruhe dangers already in the wiki (taking rule, ecology hazards, survivors, Memorial Grove/Hinewai pressure)
expectations.evidence: Lists taking-on-aruhe, razer-grass/snakewood/spiritpollen, raid survivors, Hinewai/Memorial Grove.

expectations.text: If proposing invention, cites grounding wiki pages and shows contradictions rather than writing silent canon
expectations.evidence: Cites aruhe, taking-on-aruhe, memorial-grove, Hinewai; lists contradictions vs ecology framing and Hinewai non-ruler note.
